test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the book titled 'Speaking Truth to Power : My Alternative View'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P Chidambaram.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• P. Chidambaram is the author of the book 

 
 
• **Speaking Truth to Power: My Alternative View,**
 
• Fearless in Opposition: Power and Accountability,
 
• Standing Guard: A Year in Opposition
 
 
 
• Palaniappan Chidambaram is the former Finance and Home Minister of India and a member of the Rajya Sabha from Maharashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arun Shourie** is the author of the book "Worshipping False Gods".
 
• Subramanian Swamy has come out with a book 'Human Rights and Terrorism in India'.
